title: O Ritmo e o Som da Bossa Nova
artist: Milton Banana e o Conjunto de Oscar Castro Neves
studio_context: His first record under his own name: the cover sells it on him, "o maior baterista de bossa nova", with Oscar Castro-Neves's group (flute, guitar, piano, bass). Also issued in Mexico, the US, Japan and Spain.

drum_performances.name: Milton Banana
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The brush in sixteenths on the snare and the stick on the rim, no bass drum: Moraes's example of the "samba escovado".

drums.description: The brush in sixteenths on the snare from start to end, the stick on the rim in a two-bar clave against the flute, the hi-hat foot on the "and"s from the second chorus, no bass drum.

transcriptions.note: Moraes (2020), appendix B: 153 bars of 2/4; bars 9-28 are lost.
